Specialized required courses International Organization Diplomacy Science International Economics International Law Theories And Schools Of Western International Relations Post-War International Rlations Contemporary Global Issues English For International Relations International Security Studies Politics And Policies Of EU Political required courses An Introduction To Political Science An Introduction To International Politics History Of Western Political Thoughts History Of Modern And Contemporary International Relations Contemporary Chinese Government And Politics Management Science Contemporary Diplomacy Of China Public required courses Fundamentals of Computer Applications An Introduction to Chinese Civilization An Introduction to Western Civilization Chinese-1 Chinses-2 General Introduction to China 2.Period of Study After formal admission, students will have a full-time study for 4 years in China University of Political Science and Law (CUPL). 3. Tuition and Application Fee of the Preparatory Courses Tuition is 20,000 RMB per year; application fee is 660 RMB. Those whose Chinese proficiency is under HSK level 5,without receiving preparatory courses and intend to directly enter bachelor's degree studyneed to pay the application service fee 10,000 RMB (including the related costs used for: Chinese courses, major courses, guidance to studying abroad, selection of majors and completion of relevant procedures etc.). 4. Scholarship Foreign students will obtain "the scholarship for freshmen", once they are admitted by our university as freshmen. 5. Accommodations Students can live in the students’ apartments arranged by the School of International Education, or solve accommodations by themselves.
